scope: Public isolated directory experiment; no runtime install, private catalog or other worktree writes.

plan.primary_comparison: Four new cases, three fresh arms. The old failed need gets two new arms only; its previously passing description baseline is reused and excluded from paired live aggregates.
plan.ordering: Old failure once per new candidate, then four new cases with rotating three-arm order; no passed-arm replay.
plan.scope: Public isolated directory experiment; no runtime install, private catalog or other worktree writes.

changes.baseline: Accepted description repairs and current-step selector unchanged.
changes.adaptive_gate: Raise only depth >=3 Noul retention gates by <=0.1 when retained pool >96 and adjacent score gap >=0.12; never normalize independent Nouls or force top-k.
changes.adaptive_focus: Same adaptive gates; structured Noul asks about performing a concrete required action rather than domain similarity. Original state/rules, scope text, final Choice and estimator unchanged.

plan.acceptance: All current references selected at >=0.7 and every current/later reference retained throughout all five cases. Only all-pass candidates eligible for promotion; compare costs on the four fresh complete triplets. No retry or post-live tuning.
plan.token_cap: Checked before dispatch; one response can cross it. Unknown send/usage or malformed response stops all remaining sends.
plan.limitations: One prior boundary failure and four author-written combinations; one sample per arm, not blind or population accuracy. Noul probabilities and Choice confidence are different signals; neither is locally calibrated. Provider backend revision unobservable.

offline_gate_replay.scope: Pointwise replay of existing directory scores only; no new model calls or counterfactual final accuracy. Gold never enters retention.

offline_route_replay.scope: Exact offline receipt replay, no new model sends or accuracy samples.

jev_usage_audit.unchanged_transport: Explicit typesafe provider, one process per stage, retries zero; original state/spec passed via mode-0600 temporary files.

limitations: One prior boundary failure and four author-written combinations; one sample per arm, not blind or population accuracy. Noul probabilities and Choice confidence are different signals; neither is locally calibrated. Provider backend revision unobservable.
